2893-3875-6763-8336.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Amanda Grayson trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amanda Grayson trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1

997-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.

Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

390-1651-2073-3698--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning a noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the artifact enters, Grinding Station and Hulking Metamorph trigger, untapping themselves.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Hulking Metamorph and the noncreature artifact returned in step 1, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the noncreature artifact, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve the Burdened Aerialist trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.

Repeat.

1292-3117-3446-5078.description:

Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

Cast Aang by paying its mana cost.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2909-4613-5643-6586.description:
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}
Geralf triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Rogue for each other Zombie that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Resolve the Mind Games spell, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Zombie Rogue using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding an amount of {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.
2909-4613-5643-6586.notes: The mana cost assumes you've had only one Zombie enter the battlefield this turn. If you've had two or more, the cost becomes {2}{U}{U} instead.

2557-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
2557-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
2557-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two untapped Everywhere land tokens due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 3.

4659-5365-5494-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4659-5365-5494-6441.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

2225-3767-3918-4131.description:

Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {W}.
When Rograkh dies, Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.

Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-1659-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Seed the Land and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping the creature.

Cast Heaven Sent by paying {U}{R}.
Widespread Thieving triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve Heaven Sent, choosing to have it enter the battlefield with three chapter counters on it due to its read ahead ability.

If Heaven Sent was exiled this way, repeat until Heaven Sent is not exiled.

379-1839-2125-2656-3939.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Varragoth.
Canal Dredger does not have summoning sickness.
379-1839-2125-2656-3939.description:
Activate Kuro by paying 1 life, targeting any creature not used for this combo.
Holding priority, repeat the previous step until you have 1 life remaining.
Resolve all Kuro abilities.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing all life totals to become 1.
Cast Temporal Extortion by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}.
If an opponent pays 1 life to counter it, that opponent's life total becomes 0, they lose the game, and you skip the next step.
Otherwise, resolve Temporal Extortion, gaining an extra turn.
Activate Canal Dredger by tapping it, putting Temporal Extortion from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Declare Varragoth as an attacker.
Activate Varragoth's Boast ability by paying {1}{B}, searching your library for Temporal Extortion and putting on top of your library.
Go to your next turn.
Draw Temporal Extortion in your draw step.
Repeat from step 7.

Your commander on the battlefield as a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
You have gained at least eight life this turn.

Activate your commander's second ability by tapping it, adding at least eight {U}.
Activate your commander by paying {2}{U}, causing it to become a copy of Morphling until end of turn.
Activate your commander's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1023-1769-2201-3983.description:

Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Vengeful Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Vengeful Dead die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Vengeful Dead and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Vengeful Dead trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

2104-2493-4428.description:

At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
